figures.title: Figure 10
figures.llm_description: Fig. 10   Schematic of the spintronics based on 2D materials. Elec‑ trons can be injected into 2D materials to generate spin current (the  colors present the different spin) by electrical or optical injection, in  which the electrons with different spins diffuse in the opposite direc‑ tion. The spin could be manipulated by the interface effect of the 2D  heterostructure to produce logic signals. (Color figure online)
